questions: In which country is Aer Lingus based?
Aer Lingus: Flag-carrier airline of Ireland.

Sitting just below England's top flight, this 24-club second tier traces its lineage to the old Second Division and hands its winner the trophy once awarded to England's pre-Premier-League champions — which division?
EFL Championship: English association football league.
She joined Sex and the City as the recurring Natasha, then went to the big screen in Coyote Ugly, The Sum of All Fears and I, Robot — who is this American actress and former model?
Bridget Moynahan (born April 28, 1971) is an American actress and former model.
Which of these four is biggest by area?

Cities and towns in Voronezh Oblast

Their 2001 debut EP The Modern Age sparked a bidding war among labels before they landed at RCA — which leading band of the early-2000s garage-rock revival went on to release the acclaimed Is This It?
The Strokes: American indie rock band.
Emitting beams of radiation from its magnetic poles like a cosmic lighthouse, this highly magnetized, rapidly rotating neutron star produces remarkably precise, repeating pulses — what is it?
Pulsar: Type of neutron star with beams of radiation.

A former University of Michigan football player, he became the only person to serve as both vice president and president without being elected to either office, taking the top job after Nixon resigned — who was he?
Gerald Ford: President of the United States from 1974 to 1977.
